absolute_reflection_maximality.conclusion: No proper discrete reflection overgroup exists; Delta(2,4,6) is therefore absolutely reflection-maximal and in particular maximal among arithmetic reflection groups.

arithmeticity.argument: The reflection group lies in O(G,Z) and has compact, hence finite-covolume, fundamental chamber.  Since O(G,Z) is an arithmetic lattice, the subgroup has finite index and is arithmetic.

rational_anisotropy.argument: q=0 mod 3 forces 3|z.  Put z=3z1 and divide by 3; mod 3 the equation 2x^2+xy+y^2=0 forces 3|x and 3|y.  Infinite descent excludes a nonzero rational isotropic vector.

carrier_obstruction.angle_contradiction: Distinct (-2)-curves have nonnegative integral intersection. At a finite Coxeter ridge this intersection is 0 or 1, giving only labels 2 or 3.  Delta(2,4,6) has labels 4 and 6.
carrier_obstruction.conclusion: The direct rational, certified weak-log rational, and complex exact-return minimalizable full-trace packages are all empty for this raw maximal arithmetic chamber; the bare carrier-relative third row without exact chamber return is not claimed empty.
carrier_obstruction.minimalizable_full_trace_branch: Exact Property-4 literal full-nef return gives rho=3.  A nontrivial contraction would leave Picard rank below the rank-three trace block, so the carrier is already minimal.  Canonical orthogonality of a full-rank trace block forces K numerically zero.  Adjunction then makes every irreducible negative facet a smooth rational (-2)-curve.
carrier_obstruction.rational_branches: Every smooth projective rational surface of Picard rank at least two has a pulled-back nef isotropic ruling class.  Its projectivized full nef cone is noncompact, contradicting the compact target triangle.
carrier_obstruction.rational_host_gate: The rank-three trace form is anisotropic over Q, whereas NS of a smooth rational surface of rank three is the isotropic odd unimodular form I_(1,2).  No full-rank rational similarity embedding exists.

scope.excluded_target: the exact-return Property-4 compiler obtained by combining Chamber Fidelity with the three complex carrier alternatives of canonical_chamber_rigidity_absw_transfer_theorem.md
scope.input: the compact arithmetic Coxeter triangle Delta(2,4,6), with minimal Vinberg field Q
scope.not_claimed: nonexistence for the bare carrier-relative third row without exact chamber return, or for a future carrier category which permits a proper invariant/eigen-nef slice even when k=Q
